prompts.prompt:
[SCENE]
desk-workspace preset. A compact writing desk positioned flush against a wide window, late afternoon golden hour, approximately 5:30 PM in autumn. Warm amber and copper light floods horizontally through the glass, casting long raking shadows across the desk surface. The world outside the window is softly defocused — bare tree silhouettes and a gradient sky dissolving from deep tangerine at the horizon to dusty rose higher up.

[PRODUCT PLACEMENT]
No commercial product. The clover plant in a small terracotta pot sits slightly left of center on the desk surface, its leaves catching direct golden backlight, translucent and luminous. A closed notebook with a linen cover rests at a natural angle to the right, a single dried pressed leaf laid on top as a bookmark. These objects are the visual anchors of the composition.

[HUMAN ELEMENT]
No people. No hands. Traces of presence only — the notebook positioned as if recently set down, a ceramic mug with a faint ring stain on the desk corner, a pencil resting diagonally across the notebook's edge.

[ENVIRONMENT DETAILS]
Raw oak wood grain desk surface with fine dust motes visible in the raking light. A small stack of two or three worn paperback books with softened spines beneath the terracotta pot. A thin white linen curtain panel pushed to one side, catching the breeze in a gentle billow. The window frame casts a long geometric shadow bar across the desk. Ambient dust particles suspended in the golden shaft of light, visible and intentional.

[LIGHTING]
45° camera-right side raking from the window, large ambient skylight diffusion quality, 3200K tungsten-warm golden hour color temperature bleeding into 4800K ambient room fill. Motivated practical light source — the setting sun through the window glass. Shadows: long sharp-edged shadow from the terracotta pot stretching left across the oak grain, soft falloff with gradient transition on the notebook cover, contact shadow only at base of the mug.

[LENS & CAMERA]
Shot on 50mm standard, aperture f/2.8, shallow depth of field with focus on the clover plant leaves and the front edge of the notebook, the window and exterior scene dissolving into smooth bokeh behind.

[ATMOSPHERE]
Deeply serene and contemplative. Still, unhurried, introspective. The air has the quality of late-day quiet — golden, slightly hazy, carrying warmth before the light fades. Nostalgic without being sentimental.

[COLOR PALETTE]
Burnt amber and terracotta orange as dominant warm tones. Desaturated linen cream for the notebook and curtain. Deep oak brown grounding the desk surface. Low contrast in the shadows, high luminosity in the light shafts. No saturated primaries anywhere in frame.

[STYLE REFERENCE]
In the style of Beth Kirby, Brittany Ambridge, Pia Ulin. Editorial lifestyle photography, analog warmth, quiet domestic poetry.

[QUALITY MARKERS]
Cinematic depth, hyper-realistic wood grain and fabric textures, authentic dust motes rendered with physical accuracy, translucent leaf veining visible in backlight, natural imperfections in the ceramic glaze of the pot.

[AVOID]
no AI artifacts, no warped or smeared text, no fake words baked into the image,
no plastic look, no waxy surface, no cartoonish rendering,
no extra fingers, no extra limbs, no melted geometry, no doubled subjects,
no oversaturated HDR, no HDR halos, no oversharpened look,
no flat fluorescent lighting, no harsh on-camera flash,
no generic stock photography poses, no cliché compositions,
no random unrelated brand logos, no watermarks, no signatures,
no AI sheen on surfaces, no doll-like rendering, no airbrush look,
no flat solid color bands, no empty rectangular areas, no dull gradient zones,
no stale stock photography aesthetic, no synthetic stock-photo look,
no over-staged feeling, no unrealistically clean environments,
no clipart elements, no obviously composited backgrounds,
no visible text of any kind anywhere in the image, no letters, no words, no numbers, no labels, no signage, no printed type on any surface.

resolution: 2k
